info.name: Spiko Distributor Users API
info.description: The Distributor API allows third parties like SaaS providers, fintechs or Web3 companies to distribute the Spiko Funds to their customers. With this API, you can programmatically manage investors, send subscription and redemption orders, and access real-time portfolio information.

request.description:
**Invite a new user to join an investor account.**

- If the user already has a Spiko account, they will be added directly to the investor with the specified role.
- If the user does not have a Spiko account, an invitation email will be sent.
- Returns either the created invitation or the added user depending on the scenario.

request.description:
**Resend the invitation email for a pending user invitation.**

- Only pending (not yet accepted) invitations can be resent.
- The invitation is identified by the invitee's email address.
- A new invitation email is sent to the invitee.
